summary: Election of the Chair of the Board of Health under Part H, Section 22 of the Board of Health Procedures By-law, as amended, for a term of office starting January 16, 2023 and ending December 31, 2023, and until a successor is appointed.
decided: The Board of Health: 1. Elected Director Chris Moise as Chair of the Board of Health for a term of office starting January 16, 2023 and ending December 31, 2023, and until a successor is appointed.

motions.desc: Majority required - Adopt Part 2 of Motion 1 by Councillor Chris Moise
